command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== GO084 WIRE ACCEPTED VOLATILE-STATE GUARD ==='
date -Is; hostname
SOURCE_SHA=81b92e1b1138fd86f6b011f166f4baa2349fcace
GUARD_DST=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh
DROPIN_DIR=/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d
DROPIN_DST=$DROPIN_DIR/10-volatile-state-guard.conf
# Never invent privilege; fail closed unless the established noninteractive sudo boundary exists.
sudo -n true
PRE_PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
PRE_ACTIVE=$(sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
PRE_ENTER=$(sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value)
echo PRE_ACTIVE=$PRE_ACTIVE PRE_PID=$PRE_PID PRE_ENTER=$PRE_ENTER
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go084-wire-guard.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/self-integration.git "$TMP/self-integration"
git -C "$TMP/self-integration" checkout -q --detach "$SOURCE_SHA"
test "$(git -C "$TMP/self-integration" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
GUARD_SRC="$TMP/self-integration/werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh"
DROPIN_SRC="$TMP/self-integration/werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf"
test -f "$GUARD_SRC"; test -f "$DROPIN_SRC"
echo SOURCE_SHA=$SOURCE_SHA
sha256sum "$GUARD_SRC" "$DROPIN_SRC"
# Source-level gates before any live write.
bash -n "$GUARD_SRC"
grep -Fx 'ExecCondition=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh' "$DROPIN_SRC" >/dev/null
grep -Fx 'ExecStopPost=' "$DROPIN_SRC" >/dev/null
# Prove the accepted guard still blocks the present loss condition BEFORE installation.
set +e
sudo -n "$GUARD_SRC" >/tmp/go084-prewire-guard.out 2>/tmp/go084-prewire-guard.err
PRE_GRC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/go084-prewire-guard.out; cat /tmp/go084-prewire-guard.err
echo PREWIRE_GUARD_RC=$PRE_GRC
test "$PRE_GRC" -eq 255
# Install exact accepted bytes only. No VM lifecycle action occurs here.
sudo -n install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec/entityos "$DROPIN_DIR"
sudo -n install -m 0755 "$GUARD_SRC" "$GUARD_DST"
sudo -n install -m 0644 "$DROPIN_SRC" "$DROPIN_DST"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
# Byte identity readback.
sudo -n sha256sum "$GUARD_DST" "$DROPIN_DST"
SRC_G=$(sha256sum "$GUARD_SRC" | awk '{print $1}')
SRC_D=$(sha256sum "$DROPIN_SRC" | awk '{print $1}')
DST_G=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$GUARD_DST" | awk '{print $1}')
DST_D=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$DROPIN_DST" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$SRC_G" = "$DST_G"; test "$SRC_D" = "$DST_D"
echo '--- EFFECTIVE UNIT ---'
sudo -n systemctl cat entityos-vm.service
echo '--- EFFECTIVE PROPERTIES ---'
sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecCondition -p ExecStartPre -p ExecStopPost -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic
# Exact safety assertions: guard is effective, destructive pre-start remains behind it, destructive stop-post is cleared by holding action.
EFFECTIVE=$(sudo -n systemctl cat entityos-vm.service)
printf '%s\n' "$EFFECTIVE" | grep -F 'ExecCondition=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh' >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$EFFECTIVE" | grep -F 'ExecStopPost=' >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$EFFECTIVE" | grep -F 'rm -rf \"$ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN\"' >/dev/null
# Run guard manually only; rc=255 is the required real-host protection result.
set +e
sudo -n "$GUARD_DST" >/tmp/go084-postwire-guard.out 2>/tmp/go084-postwire-guard.err
POST_GRC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/go084-postwire-guard.out; cat /tmp/go084-postwire-guard.err
echo POSTWIRE_GUARD_RC=$POST_GRC
test "$POST_GRC" -eq 255
POST_PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
POST_ACTIVE=$(sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
POST_ENTER=$(sudo -n systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value)
echo POST_ACTIVE=$POST_ACTIVE POST_PID=$POST_PID POST_ENTER=$POST_ENTER
test "$PRE_PID" = "$POST_PID"
test "$PRE_ACTIVE" = "$POST_ACTIVE"
test "$PRE_ENTER" = "$POST_ENTER"
echo LIVE_GUARD_SHA256=$DST_G
echo LIVE_DROPIN_SHA256=$DST_D
echo '=== PASS: ACCEPTED GUARD WIRED; VM PID/LIFECYCLE UNCHANGED ==='
